correctness.rationale: Dimensionless map F(z,w)=(z-cg(s),s), s=βw+(1-β)z, g(s)=s/sqrt(1+s²), has unique origin fixed point. Direct Jacobian has determinant β and trace 1+β-d(1-β); Jury inequalities give c*=2(1+β)/(1-β). At criticality eigenvalues -1 and -β: transformed center coordinate has u^+=-u+t u³+O(u^4), yielding u_n^{-2}/n→2t for nontrivial center-manifold orbits and local full-state attraction, nonexponential. Momentum balancing an arbitrary two-cycle, not presuming symmetry, plus odd strict monotonicity of g forces opposite states and exactly one positive amplitude Z=t^{-1}sqrt((ct/2)²-1) for c>c*. The cycle Jacobian coefficient d=8/(c²t³)<c* satisfies strict Jury conditions; monodromy square is attracting. Independent Jacobian/eigenvalue and amplitude/stability computations checked 20 parameter choices including β=0 and β=.99. Higher periods and global basins not asserted.
